response: Useful Markdown reply: briefly record findings and supporting evidence from supplied results, decisions, and the purpose of pending tool calls. Empty text is allowed with calls; otherwise provide a nonblank answer or ask for needed information.
tool_calls: Ordered tools to execute after validation; [] for a final answer.
suggestions: Optional prompts that logically extend this turn's actions; clicks submit them exactly as supplied.
session_title: Short Title Case name for an untitled conversation; include only when the Session Title section asks for one.
call_id: Nonempty identifier unique within this batch.
arguments: JSON-encoded object matching the tool's parameter schema. Use '{}' for no arguments.
previous_results: Compress all actual previous-batch results in past tense, including failures, findings, and verification. Use an empty string only when no results were supplied.
user_request: Describe what the user requested and corrected, preserving constraints, goals, paths, and identifiers. Include the ongoing request on continuation calls.
current_step: Compress this response, all planned calls, decisions, and remaining work. Mark requested calls as pending.
